patthana24.19:3.1: na saraṇaṃ na sanidassanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sanidassano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.19:5.1: na saraṇaṃ na sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.19:7.1: na saraṇaṃ na rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo rūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā dve.
patthana24.19:8.1: na saraṇaṃ na arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saraṇo arūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā dve.

patthana24.19:10.1: na saraṇaṃ na lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā araṇo lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekaṃ,
patthana24.19:11.1: na saraṇaṃ na kenaci viññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo kenaci viññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
